features.title: Action Status Filter in Minutes Panel
acceptance: MinutesPanel shows a filter control for action status (all, open, in_progress, blocked, done, cancelled)
Filter applies to displayed actions only, not decisions/questions
Filter state resets when switching meetings
Keyboard accessible with proper ARIA labels

features.title: Action Status Counts in Filter Dropdown
acceptance: Filter dropdown shows action count per status (e.g., 'Open (3)', 'In progress (1)')
Count updates when actions are added/removed/transitioned
Count only includes action items, not decisions/questions
